changes.text: Daywatch — a light theme for keeping the log in daylight.
FAQ answers now slide in smoothly and only one question stays open at a time.
Update notice no longer hidden behind the log button — now appears as a centred dialog.
Opening the app from a reminder notification now goes directly to the log entry screen.
Lantern is now available on Google Play.
Nightly condition log — Storm, Squall, Overcast, Settled, Clear.
Watch Notes and Watch Needs — optional tokens per entry.
Logbook calendar heatmap — Seafarer and Nautical palettes.
The raven — pattern-based observation after each entry.
The Tides — waveform, condition breakdown, and monthly record.
The Harbourmaster — weekly note drawn from your log.
Evening bell — optional daily reminder.
Plain text export.
Passcode and fingerprint lock.
Late entry backfilling from the logbook.
Recent nights on the Watch screen — last 5 entries with condition colours and watch note tags
FAB now positioned correctly above the navigation bar across all device types
Saving an edit from a notification tap returns to the Watch screen
Log card taps from the Watch screen return to Watch after saving
Duplicate GlobalKey error when switching tabs
Router no longer recreated on settings changes
Splash screen freeze after enabling the daily reminder
Notification now opens the edit screen if today's entry is already logged
Scheduled reminder no longer lost after an app update
Lock screen vertical centering
Fingerprint lock now requires a passcode fallback before enabling
Passcode and fingerprint setup flows are now independent
Heatmap colour palette tuned
Edge-to-edge display compatibility for Android 15
